name: GPMC Sensory-Emotional Record Template
purpose: Define the required shape for turning a GPM PIX or K-KUT into a safe, multi-sensory emotional interpretation record before public buyer use.
core_law: Slice as thinly as the emotional meaning remains complete. Do not slice thinner than human meaning.

required_fields.source_pix_id_or_track_id: source PIX, track, or approved source id
required_fields.source_type: PIX | KK | KUT | II | section | line_pair | phrase_cluster | ending_tail
required_fields.public_option_id: optional approved public option id when published

audio: tempo, softness, vocal grain, silence, lift, tension, release, ending feel
body: warmth, ache, pulse, settling, pressure, release, grounded
visual: light, dark, color, distance, weather, motion, stillness
touch: soft, sharp, held, heavy, airy, fragile, warm, cold
memory: first love, old home, parent care, apology, lost chance, still choosing, goodbye

emotional_coordinates.social_direction: toward | away | returning | staying | releasing | witnessing

bad_use_cases: where this record may confuse, pressure, or harm
required_fields.human_review_notes: why this status is safe or not safe

non_exploitation_laws: Do not diagnose the buyer or receiver.
Do not claim to know the receiver's inner state.
Do not use grief, apology, longing, or romance to pressure a purchase.
Do not sell emotion as a commodity.
public_approval_gate: audio_delivery_url must be public and working
good_use_cases and bad_use_cases must both be present
sensory approval is independent of payment state, price, and payment provider

example_record.interpretation_summary: Send something that says I still choose you.
risk_notes: Do not imply the song fixes the relationship.
receiver_safe_words: This made me think of us.
I wanted to send something warm.
do_not_say: You have to feel the same.
example_record.human_review_notes: Approved because the route is anniversary-specific, warm, non-coercive, and public audio/payment proof exists.
